name: flat-p3-w4
description: W4, the ply-4 twin. The analyst's warm-started twins (theory-2 6.17), the ply ladder's next rung: is ply-4 training data better than ply-3 data for ply-4 play? flat-p3-w4 and flat-p3-w3 differ only in the field's ply (4 and 3), so the ply of the training games is the one factor; the same starts, seed 24, 6 rounds a cycle, a scaled plateau from cycle 60, at most 100 cycles. Each of the four F-L lines starts from flat-p3's final model of the same line (version 199 of F-L#1-4.loc; its version 0 is a byte copy, path and md5 in config.json and the 'entered' event), and its first training divides the AdaGrad sums by 8 (start_forget 8: train --start <version 0> --init-forget 8) so the models can adapt again; later trainings as usual. Pure field with self-games and no references, standard T 0.1 tournament on chessai-hybrid10 (chessai-hybrid11 not built yet), prices P2 (ply 4: lr measured, 2026-11-11). Read: both twins' final versions against their common start (flat-p3 v199) and each other at ply 4, near argmax (T 0.02). Cost (NEXT-EXPERIMENTS.md): W4 ~3-5 CPU-h, W3 ~0.5 CPU-h. Written 11-11 ~03:30 for the coordinator to launch.
